build_DSNTHead: build a DSNTHead model with custom in_channels, num_joints, and beta parameters for pose regression
create_DSNTHead_loss: create a DSNTHead loss calculation that computes keypoint and heatmap losses from batch inputs
test_DSNTHead_forward: test the DSNTHead forward pass to verify predicted coordinates and heatmaps output
review_DSNTHead_lambda_t: review the DSNTHead lambda_t parameter that discards heatmap loss after a specified epoch
refactor_DSNTHead_debias: refactor the DSNTHead debias option to remove Integral Pose Regression bias using Gu et al method
